FULL TEXT:
No. D/UIPS/24/2459 Dated 25.07.2024
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for two (02) post of Guest Faculty in the subject of Pharmaceutics
for the academic session 2024-2025 (odd semester) in University Institute of Pharmaceutical
Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh for B.Pharm. and M.Pharm. Classes.
Applications complete in all respects (please refer to :
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf )along with
a recent passport size photograph, copies of degrees, certificates of merit, awards
(scholarships / fellowships), lists of publications and other supporting documents must
reach the Department office by 30.07.2024 before 5:00 PM by email
(chairperson.uips@pu.ac.in )
Essential Qualifications:-
Good academic record with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually
Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed
at the B. Pharm. and M. Pharm. level from an Indian University or an equivalent degree
from an accredited foreign University.
Desirable:
Ph.D.
First preference will be given to Ph.D/GPAT qualified candidates
The candidates are also required to submit the hard copy (one copy only) to the office of the
Chairperson, University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University
Chandigarh-160 014 latest by 30.07.2024 before 5.00 p.m.
Interview Schedule:
Date 01.08.2024
Reporting Time 2:30 p.m.
The above teaching assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shal have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/ stipend or any financial assistance
from any agency during the tenure of teaching at UIPS
Working hours for the appointee will be from 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m, Monday to Friday
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
Sd/-
Anil Kumar
Professor & Chairperson
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
Panjab University, Chandigarh
